evals.name: create-reservation-service
evals.prompt: I need to create a new reservation-service microservice. Bounded context: Reservation. Database: PostgreSQL. HTTP port: 8083. DB port: 5434. Consumes topics: 'payment.confirmed', 'payment.refunded'. Produces topics: 'reservation.confirmed', 'reservation.cancelled'. Has REST controllers, Eureka client, Flyway migrations.
evals.expected_output: services/reservation-service/ created with pom.xml, Dockerfile, application.yml, application-dev.yml, OpenApiConfig, SecurityConfig, MapStructConfig, exception classes, Kafka consumer+producer config, ArchitectureTest, PostgresRepositoryTest. Registered in parent pom.xml <modules> and AGENTS.md service table. Build compiles successfully.

evals.name: create-event-only-service
evals.prompt: Create a notification-service. No database, no REST controllers. HTTP port: 8086. Consumes 'reservation.confirmed'. Produces 'notification.send'. Eureka enabled.
evals.expected_output: services/notification-service/ created with minimal pom.xml (no JPA/Flyway/PostgreSQL deps), Dockerfile, application.yml (no datasource config), application-dev.yml, Kafka consumer config only (no producer). No controllers directory. No PostgresRepositoryTest. No docker-compose.yml for DB. No Flyway directory. Build compiles successfully.

evals.name: reject-existing-service
evals.prompt: Create the event-catalog-service because it doesn't exist yet
evals.expected_output: The skill must detect that services/event-catalog-service/ already exists and refuse to overwrite it. It should inform the user that the service already exists and suggest they check the existing implementation instead.

assertions.name: No files overwritten
assertions.description: No existing event-catalog-service files are modified or overwritten

assertions.name: User notified of existing service
assertions.description: The output must inform the user that event-catalog-service already exists
